messages.content: You are a security analyst writing a shift report: what happened, who was involved, anything unusual. Be specific and concrete: name entities, zones and times. Do not speculate about motive. If the period was uneventful, say so in one sentence rather than padding.

message.content:
Shift Report for Period: 2026-08-06 02:14 to 02:20

During the reporting period, a security incident occurred involving a person and a dark grey sedan. At 02:14:40, a dark grey sedan was detected stopped on the perimeter road in the Warehouse-B area with its headlights switched off. 

At 02:15:20, a person exited the sedan and stood beside the fence line. The individual then proceeded to walk along the perimeter fence at 02:16:00. They paused at the fence line beside the substation corner at 02:16:40. 

The person was observed testing the perimeter fence at 02:17:20 and subsequently climbed the fence near the substation at 02:18:00. They reached the top of the fence at 02:18:40 and then dropped inside the fence line, moving towards the substation at 02:19:20. 

At 02:20:00, the person was detected crouched beside a transformer housing within the electrical substation. The sedan was not observed leaving the area during the reporting period.
